name: Calibration Schedule Per Serial No
query:
SELECT
 cs.parent AS "Serial No:Link/Serial No:160",
 sn.item_code AS "Item:Link/Item:150",
 it.item_name AS "Item Name::180",
 sn.custom_item_tag AS "Item Tag::120",
 cs.sequence AS "Calibration #:Int:110",
 cs.frequency AS "Frequency::110",
 cs.due_date AS "Due Date:Date:110",
 cs.status AS "Status::120",
 cs.calibration_task AS "Task:Link/Task:150"
FROM `tabCalibration Schedule` cs
JOIN `tabSerial No` sn ON sn.name = cs.parent AND cs.parenttype = 'Serial No'
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` it ON it.name = sn.item_code
ORDER BY cs.parent, cs.due_date
